description: Rough cost of a renovation or home repair job in the Netherlands (verbouwing kosten, renovatie kosten, schilderen kosten per m2, renovation cost Netherlands). Call it when someone asks what a job such as painting, roofing, flooring, plumbing, insulation or a general renovation will roughly cost in a Dutch city, before quotes are requested. Input: one job category, the area in m2 and the city. Returns a planning figure in EUR: labour hours (h) times an hourly rate (EUR per hour, excluding VAT) plus the listed material lines in EUR, a low, typical and high range in EUR, the VAT basis of every amount, the source and date of every figure, as_of, the answer schema version and a signed receipt that can be checked offline against the published AstraNL log key. A planning figure for one job category, not a quote and not the full scope of a job. Same input and answer as estimate_cost. Read-only, free, no account.

area_m2.description: Surface area or working volume in square meters. Optional but improves accuracy. For non-area tasks pass 0 for a labour-only planning figure. Omitting area_m2 assumes 20 m2. Send a JSON number such as 40, not the text "40".

category.description: The closest trade word, for example renovation, painting, plumbing, roofing, flooring. Same enum as create_task.

location.description: City in the Netherlands. Optional; defaults to Netherlands. No regional price adjustment is applied (location_mult = 1.0).

name: astranl_renovation_estimate_nl
title: Renovation cost estimate, Netherlands (verbouwing kosten)
